referenceComparison.independentReview: Rounds/Economy agent confirmed final Economy PC/mobile captures and additionally checked Rounds/Performance/Duels PC/mobile screenshots. Parent also reviewed final desktop Performance/Duels and mobile Scoreboard.

visualDebuggingFeedback.finding: Economy grid auto track expanded the entire active panel to the 1290px scoreboard minimum width at narrow viewports. Top controls and empty-state notice were clipped despite zero document overflow.
visualDebuggingFeedback.resolution: TrackerEconomy.module.css .economy gained grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr), keeping table scrolling inside its own wrapper.
visualDebuggingFeedback.verification: Final 42 groups and 20 responsive conditions rerun with active tabpanel scrollWidth<=clientWidth check; all 17 modal screenshots regenerated. Independent CSS audit25 also passed; final mobile Economy directly re-inspected.

testSetupNotes: One preview failure was caused by a nested Playwright has locator that repeated its parent scope for the KAST metric. The locator was corrected to the local dl row; no application change was needed.
Mobile modal covers the whole viewport, so desktop backdrop dismissal is tested and mobile uses Escape/close button.
Horizontal scrolling is intentional only inside tab strip/tables/participant and round strips; active tabpanel and page widths remain bounded.

limitations: Chromium only; no Safari/Firefox or real-device touch run.
